items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 11 at 2:40PM PDT until September 12 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 25 kt with occasional gusts up to 35 kt
expected.

* WHERE...Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...From 9 AM to 9 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
